[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Wildcard matching** [LC 44 · Wildcard Matching](https://leetcode.com/problems/wildcard-matching/){difficulty="Hard"}

A star that is allowed to be empty and allowed to grow by one character is two arrows, not a search. The first star of `*a*b` on `adceb` is empty, `a` takes the first letter, and the second star takes `dce`. No other split works, because there is only one `a`, but the table does not have to know that in advance.

[Solved in full in @sec-st-p4-wild.]{.card-link}
